resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 1948. The Forest Lookouts page quotes a 1959 article saying a ranger had been stationed at the Kings Park tower since 1947. The story reports both and does not settle the date.
The register says the state removed the tower in 1960 and the land is now privately held. The Forest Lookouts page says the title passed to Suffolk County in October 1959. The story reports both.

notes_for_editor: The identity of the Oak Orchard tower is not confirmed. The FFLA lists a platform tower relocated from Kings Park, and Wikipedia mentions an observation tower on Albion Road without linking it to Kings Park. A Facebook post by the FFLA New York chapter reportedly says the lower 47 feet were re-erected at Oak Orchard; the page did not open beyond its title, so the story does not use it. Standing rests on the FFLA list alone. The register's 1948 build date and the 1947 staffing date disagree, and the sources disagree about who controlled the tower after 1959. Searches: 1 WebSearch plus a cache search; about 5 distinct pages read.
